reason: The orthorhombic cell, Z=1 for BaSr3Zr4Se12, and the EuZrSe3-type average chain framework are strongly supported, and the submitted model is chemically plausible. However, exact recovery is not sufficiently established: the only final candidate was obtained by imposing parent-Pnma orbit relations on an EuZrSe3 prototype and then placing Ba on one A site, while the element-specific structure actually has lower maximal symmetry (reported by the trace as Pm, but submitted as P1). The trajectory did not instantiate and whole-pattern-compare an unconstrained lower-symmetry coordinate model, an averaged versus ordered Ba/Sr model, or other scientifically motivated coordinate/order realizations. Its reported Rwp of about 0.067 is an internal custom-profile value, and no comparable whole-pattern score was supplied. Thus the fit supports the cell and average framework much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, exact coordinates, and occupational realization; a further attempt could plausibly improve or broaden the exact candidate set.
